# Darkroom keyboard shortcuts

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/shortcuts`

## Summary

Every Darkroom keyboard shortcut, by category (press ? in the editor to see them).

## Details

### Tools
- V: Selection tool
- C: Razor tool (click a clip to cut)
- Y: Slip tool (re-window source)
- U: Slide tool (neighbors absorb)
- H: Hand tool (pan timeline)
### Editing
- ⌘/Ctrl+K: Split at playhead
- S: Toggle snapping
- Q: Ripple-trim previous edit to playhead
- W: Ripple-trim next edit to playhead
- Del or ⌫: Ripple delete
- ⌘/Ctrl+D: Apply default transition
- T: Add title clip at playhead
- G: Group selected clips
- Shift+G: Ungroup selected clips
- Shift+D: Detach audio
- M: Add marker at playhead
### Playback
- Space: Play / pause
- ←: Step back one frame
- →: Step forward one frame
### View
- + or =: Zoom in
- - or _: Zoom out
- Shift+M: Show / hide markers panel
- ?: Keyboard shortcuts
### History
- ⌘/Ctrl+Z: Undo
- ⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y: Redo
